note.windows: Point it at your Afterlife CD (the Windows 95 one; the folder holding ALIFE.EXE and ALIFE.000), or a copy of its files. The build takes about 5 minutes and 2 GB. Python and the Visual Studio Build Tools are installed if they are missing; the Build Tools are about 3 GB and add 15 to 30 minutes, and Windows asks for permission once.
